projectDescription: EduPets is a browser-based educational platform for primary-school children that combines a virtual pet care game with math exercises (addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division) to motivate learning through play.
keyFeatures: Virtual penguin pet with food, sleep, and happiness stats that decay over time
Four math exercise modes: addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division
Mixed-operation exam mode with 5 questions and a lives system
Task system linking pet stat boosts to completing specific exercise types
Persistent state via localStorage (pet name, levels, active task)
Background music player embedded via iframe
Animated canvas background on the home screen
FastAPI backend serving Jinja2 HTML templates
publicApiSurface: GET /que-es — What is EduPets? info page
GET /por-que — Why we built it info page
